author: Karl Rock
description:
This historical marvel belongs to the tomb of Mirza Isa Khan Tarkhan, a 17th-century ruler of Thatta, Sindh. The intricate carvings reveal a fascinating blend of cultural and religious motifs, displaying a Star of David, a cross, and a swastika side by side.

These symbols reflect the diverse influences and historical tolerance present in the region during the Tarkhan dynasty. It is a rare glimpse into a time when artistic expression transcended boundaries, leaving behind a mysterious architectural legacy that continues to intrigue history buffs and travelers alike.
title: Religious Symbols on Ancient Grave
